children: Turkish central bank data showed that 16 metric tons of gold were returned to reserves, with bankers saying on Thursday that a last U.S. dollar-gold swap had matured.
The gold swaps, conducted since start of Iran war, had previously rolled over at maturity.
The bankers said around $1.8 billion worth of gold was returned to reserves last week.
The central bank declined to comment. The data showed international gold reserves increased by 16 tons last week to 791.4 tons.
